candidates.description: Only increase fixed slope ridge penalty from 20 to 80, reduce feature sensitivity
Only change fixed ensemble weights from 70/30 to 35/65 ridge/trend
Only train direct target up to 252 sessions instead of 63, keep all other parameters

rules: No random shuffle; training prefixes and all preprocessing end at each origin.
Target and origin must both be inside the declared phase; crossing targets are purged.
Selection uses development and validation only. Freeze selection before revealing holdout.
No repeated search after seeing holdout; rejected candidate is not adjusted this round.
Primary errors and gates use non-overlapping target blocks; overlapping monthly-origin records are labelled diagnostics only.
External inputs unavailable before their first observed archive are excluded. These tests are price-only.
Historical data were inspected in prior releases; the reserved tail is held out for this round, not a never-seen independent dataset. True prospective forecasts remain separate.
Long horizons without enough non-overlapping targets are not tuned or advertised as validated.
